The '''Hermit's Vigil''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It could be stored in a tailored holster.<ref name="Cartel Market" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hermit's Vigil was first introduced in the [[Cartel Market]] of [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''<ref name="Cartel Market" /> as part of the Game Update 7.3, released on [[June 13]] [[2023]].<ref name=TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230613-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 7.3}}</ref> The weapon was designed by [[Wesley Johnson]]<ref name="Johnson">{{ArtStation|username=derezzurektion|url=artwork/XJPB3L|name=[[Wesley Johnson]]|text=SWTOR &#124; Hermit's Vigil Blaster Pistol|date=2024-11-01|quote=This is a blaster pistol and accompanying holster that I made for update 7.3 of Star Wars The Old Republic.}}</ref> and it's design was heavily inspired by<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=SWTOR|url=status/1653832504694939679|name=''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''|date=2023-05-03|quote=Here is a preview of some of the items that will be released on the Cartel Market! The Hermit's Vigil, Obi-Wan inspired blaster and the CP-2 Bryar Pistol, Cassian inspired blaster.}}</ref> the [[BR-14 blaster]]<ref name="The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the [[canon]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Part II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref>
